decision_basis.approved_decision: Keep Term registry and Term//ID; authoritative Term Definitions are Method/Form (not Method Type).
decision_basis.gap: Current M450 uses Method/Form Term Definition and exactly introduces Term//ID, while current R1319 Claim and Details still say Method Type. A narrow same-Summary Type-to-Form preview closes that wording conflict; a separate Form Declaration admits the Form and E659 evaluates it.
decision_basis.resolution: Prepare one exact Method/Form Declaration and a minimal E659 terminology/prerequisite correction. Root allocates the declaration ID after checking full history. Do not restore archived CA-R-2453 as Current.
decision_basis.inherited_structure: The qualified Method Form specializes and retains the existing Method role under CA-R-2513; declaration creates no alternate Method kind or new meaning-owner policy.

non_actions: Do not retire R2275 until Method Form is admitted and M450 passes E659.
Do not change ID meaning, Term registry, parser, runtime, Current sources, or source history.

term_kind.claim: CA-R-1318@33 defines Term as a reusable lexical kind and references Term//ID; it does not by itself define ID meaning.

governed_term_rule.current_claim: Current Claim still says Method Type; the pinned candidate changes only Type-to-Form wording.
governed_term_rule.candidate: Exactly one active Method/Form Term Definition owns each governed Term.

target_admission.rule: A defining Claim may explicitly introduce its governed lexical Term target; lexical composition and type/form declaration alone do not create the target.

m450.claim: Explicitly introduces the lexical Term instance named ID at Term//ID.

target_binding_review.e659_fixture: Explicit ID Term Definition fixture governs Term//ID and requires target binding evidence; the new Method Form declaration admits only the form and does not create or rename any Term target.
target_binding_review.result: M450 and E659 use the exact existing flat Term//ID target. CA-R-1318 defines Term, R1319 names the flat Term//Name family including Term//ID, and R1194/R1931 allow explicit claim introduction. New Form Declaration does not create or rename any target or namespace.
